headline: Refex Industries submits Q2FY27 results
summary: Refex Industries submitted machine-readable Q2FY27 results. Standalone revenue rose 36% YoY to ₹55,951 lakh, while consolidated revenue jumped 84% to ₹76,132 lakh.

headline: Sonata settles US $5.25 mn litigation with ex-promoter
summary: Sonata Software subsidiaries settled employment and stock disputes with former promoter Srinivas Veeravelli for US $5.25 million, releasing deferred payment obligations.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Bharat Forge, Titagarh, PWL in focus
summary: Bharat Forge rallies on defence orders and capital infusion, while Titagarh Rail Systems secures a ₹65 crore order. PhysicsWallah targets ₹10,000 crore revenue by FY30.
